rule: Every required case must be implemented as an assertion over parsed structures or callable behavior; source-string presence is insufficient.

required_cases.assertion: floor conversion maps normalized [0.20,0.34] at 1280x720 to [256,244]
9x9 original bounds are x252..260/y240..248 and contain exactly 81 unique pixels
13x13 ownership footprint is center +/-6 and contains exactly 169 unique pixels
for every in-bounds integer sample, normalized pixel-center formula ((x+0.5)/1280,(y+0.5)/720) floors back to [x,y]
one exact target owner/component/SIDE key over all 169 pixels plus passing sensitivity yields ORIGINAL_VALID
one exact foreign owner inside the 9x9 yields BRANCH_A_SAMPLE_REPLACEMENT
one exact foreign owner only in the two-pixel perimeter yields BRANCH_A_SAMPLE_REPLACEMENT
a repeatable mixed/boundary pixel in the footprint is boundary-unsafe and yields Branch A
missing, malformed, unstable, or unaccounted owner pixels yield BLOCKED/NOT TESTABLE — HARNESS
all 169 exact target pixels plus flat target response yields BRANCH_B_RENDER_CONSUMER_BINDING
a center at squared distance 1024 is considered and a center at 1025 is not
a fully target-material patch in a different visible connected component is ineligible
a target-owned TOP or BOTTOM patch is ineligible; SIDE is required
168 matching pixels and one nonmatching footprint pixel is ineligible
eligible centers are selected by ascending squared_distance, then y, then x
an empty eligible list emits exactly DIRECTOR DECISION REQUIRED — NO ROBUST OUTER-CLOSURE SAMPLE
arbitrary permutations of RGB, Y, thresholds and check results with the same owner map cannot change component or sample selection
selector callable and transcript accept no RGB, Y, response magnitude, threshold, or pass/fail input
a brighter or more responsive farther eligible center cannot displace the first (d2,y,x) tuple
base < midpoint < extreme with unrelated exact RGB8 equality and safe ownership passes
changed whole-image hashes or many changed pixels with a flat corrected median emits BLOCKED/NOT TESTABLE — MEASUREMENT BINDING
base >= midpoint or midpoint >= extreme emits measurement-binding blocker
one corrected-patch RGB8 triplet changed by UNRELATED_EXTREME emits measurement-binding blocker
shadow-off medians and masks are required but do not introduce a new numerical threshold
Y>=0.075 and Y<=ground-0.12 is recognized as a valid low separation branch
Y>=ground+0.12 is recognized as a valid high separation branch

with ground 0.1991557292161208 and synthetic monotonic Y values 0.2950366856, 0.3840860532 and 0.4754721832, baseline fails separation while midpoint and extreme reach the high branch; obsolete [0.075,0.0791557292161208] cannot reject them
candidate eligibility evaluates all 21 hard checks and never treats measured_Y_feasible_interval or balanced_target_Y as a hard threshold
every candidate recomputes the old sample and labels it historical_non_gating with gating=false
missing/mislabeled old history is rejected, and its values cannot enter the 21-check array, local_pass, combined selection or terminal result
changing only historical non-gating values cannot change candidate status or selection
after diagnostic PASS, launches/index are zero, records/cache empty, and candidate root empty before first outer endpoint
a v1.2.7R1 run ID, candidate record, or cache entry is rejected from v1.2.8 state
5/10 diagnostic launch counters do not increment or reduce the frozen 82 calibration-candidate cap
ownership+sensitivity PASS and a complete bound registered stage transcript with no eligible candidate may emit NO_PRESENTATION_ONLY_INTERVAL
executed-complete records with a missing planned step cannot emit NO_PRESENTATION_ONLY_INTERVAL
reaching a cap before the registered transcript completes cannot emit NO_PRESENTATION_ONLY_INTERVAL
missing ownership, flat sensitivity, incomplete evidence, or invalid runtime result cannot emit NO_PRESENTATION_ONLY_INTERVAL
Branch B expected bytes accept only the registered target render-consumer binding and reject geometry, neighboring, unrelated-material, camera or threshold changes
a target extreme influence pixel outside the exact target-owner mask rejects the repair
the successor contains the same 21 check IDs and 14 ray expectations; only the authorized visual sample coordinate may differ
each registered terminal calls one finalizer before cleanup and produces inventory, evidence ZIP, ZIP tests and fresh-extraction verification
diagnostic materials, owner passes, editor state and caches never appear in implemented-source or prepared-session inventories
prepared result is written before the complete session inventory and fresh extraction verifies every session file
automation success records zero human attempts, HWG NOT PERFORMED and P1B FROZEN
